rationale: With only 21 minutes to close and price consolidating in a tight range near $21.29-$21.31 with very low per-candle volume (3,000-14,000 shares), there is no clear directional momentum to exploit. The stock sits at 85% of its daily range with the 9-EMA at $21.33 acting as mild resistance just above, and the ATR of $0.053 on 5-minute bars is too small relative to spread and slippage risk to generate a meaningful risk/reward before forced liquidation. The account is already down on the day and the setup does not justify adding risk this close to the close.
